summary: Catalogs, docs-as-code systems, knowledge graphs and architecture tools provide complementary layers. The pattern succeeds only when ownership and update triggers connect them to delivery work.

items.text: Backstage Software Catalog plus TechDocs: maps owned components and places versioned technical documentation beside catalog entities.
Docusaurus: docs-as-code, search and explicit documentation versioning support a browsable human/agent knowledge layer.
Obsidian Graph View and properties: bidirectional links plus structured metadata can expose relationships among decisions, incidents and components.
Structurizr: a model-based C4 workspace can generate consistent architecture views instead of maintaining disconnected diagrams.
